<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="kXeEuuULe5fwdQbXJ3WL"> <mxGraphModel dx="2707" dy="1011" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "
@startuml
title SEQUENCE DIAGRAM - PLACE ORDER AND PAYMENT

actor Customer
participant \"Next.js UI\" as UI
participant \"NestJS API\" as API
database Database as DB
participant \"Payment Service\" as PS

autonumber

== 1. Place Order ==

Customer -> UI: Select products and click Checkout
UI -> API: POST /api/orders\nJWT + OrderRequest
activate API

API -> API: Verify JWT
API -> API: Validate order data

alt JWT invalid
 API --> UI: 401 Unauthorized
 UI --> Customer: Request login again

else JWT valid

 alt Invalid order data
 API --> UI: 400 Bad Request
 UI --> Customer: Display validation errors

 else Valid order data

 API -> DB: Check products and stock
 activate DB
 DB --> API: Product information and stock
 deactivate DB

 alt Insufficient stock
 API --> UI: 409 Insufficient stock
 UI --> Customer: Display out-of-stock message

 else Stock available

 group Database Transaction
 API -> DB: BEGIN TRANSACTION
 API -> DB: INSERT Order (PENDING_PAYMENT)
 API -> DB: INSERT OrderItems
 API -> DB: UPDATE product stock
 API -> DB: COMMIT
 DB --> API: Transaction successful
 end

 API --> UI: 201 Created\norderId + totalAmount
 UI --> Customer: Display order information

 == 2. Payment Request ==

 Customer -> UI: Confirm payment
 UI -> API: POST /api/payments\norderId + Idempotency-Key
 API -> API: Verify JWT and validate payment request

 API -> DB: Find Idempotency-Key
 activate DB
 DB --> API: Existing key or not found
 deactivate DB

 alt Idempotency key already exists
 API -> DB: Get previous payment result
 DB --> API: Existing payment status
 API --> UI: Return previous result/status
 UI --> Customer: Display existing payment status

 else New Idempotency key

 API -> DB: Save payment request (PENDING)
 DB --> API: Payment request saved

 API -> PS: Create payment\norderId + amount + Idempotency-Key
 activate PS

 alt Payment successful
 PS --> API: Payment Success + transactionId

 group Update successful payment
 API -> DB: BEGIN TRANSACTION
 API -> DB: Update Payment = PAID
 API -> DB: Update Order = CONFIRMED
 API -> DB: COMMIT
 DB --> API: Update successful
 end

 API --> UI: 200 OK\nPayment successful + order details
 UI --> Customer: Display payment success

 else Payment failed
 PS --> API: Payment Failed

 group Handle failed payment
 API -> DB: BEGIN TRANSACTION
 API -> DB: Update Payment = FAILED
 API -> DB: Cancel order or set retry status
 API -> DB: Restore stock if order cancelled
 API -> DB: COMMIT
 DB --> API: Update successful
 end

 API --> UI: Payment failed + reason
 UI --> Customer: Display payment failure\nand retry option
 end

 deactivate PS
 end
 end
 end
end

deactivate API
@enduml

 "config": null
